<thought>We need to determine how many carbonyl (C=O) groups are present in the unknown molecule. The most direct inexpensive measurement is IR spectroscopy, which shows characteristic C=O stretching bands around 1700 cm⁻¹. By obtaining the IR spectrum and counting distinct carbonyl stretch peaks, we can infer the number of carbonyl groups.</thought>
